entities.name: Killing of Nguyễn Xuân Đạt
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On January 25, 2025, Nguyễn Xuân Đạt was killed and dismembered, in what was later described as a consensual homicide, in the Hữu Lũng commune of the Vietnamese province of Lạng Sơn. The killing, which had been filmed, became known internationally as The Vietnamese Butcher case after Vice published an article calling the film, dubbed The Vietnamese Butcher, the "first real snuff movie" following its circulation on social media shock sites in late July 2025.
